content.text: {"episodes":[{"ep":10,"title":"Two Days Before","lines":[{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"By the next morning, Devraj's apology had reached every courtyard. So had another fact. Kavita had found the five lakh rupees.","sfx_cue":"police station gate clanging shut, crowded voices"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"You froze my cousin's cooperative account without one question to me.","sfx_cue":"papers slapped onto wooden desk"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"I am asking now. Explain the deposit dated the third of May, twenty twenty-one.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"It was for a tractor.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You said the money was not paid to you. You did not say it was sitting with your cousin.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Because it was not my account. That distinction is usually understood by adults.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Speak without insulting my daughter.","sfx_cue":"crowd murmuring closer"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Your family arrangements change very quickly, Devraj.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"My mistake does not make your answer true.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Good. Everyone has finished performing. Sit down, Raghav.","sfx_cue":"chair dragged across concrete"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I prefer to stand.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then stand beside the account statement, where everybody can see both of you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"The public desk became a hearing without a judge. Villagers filled the doorway. Meera stood where she could see Raghav's face.","sfx_cue":"ceiling fan rattling, low crowd murmur"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Cooperative account ending four one nine two. Account holder, Raghav's cousin. Deposit, five lakh rupees. Date, third of May, twenty twenty-one.","sfx_cue":"paper unfolded"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Correct. A commercial deposit is not a crime.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Who deposited it?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"A tractor buyer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"The papers are old. I cannot remember every farmer who asks for machinery.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"But you remembered the date in front of the village. Eighteen months later. Before I told police the amount.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I remembered because the accusation was repeated to me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"By whom?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"People talk.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Name one person.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"This is becoming theatrical.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"No. Theatre gives the audience a lie and tells them it is a lie. You asked us to call yours truth.","sfx_cue":"one villager claps, then stops"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I arranged a tractor inquiry. That is why the date stayed in my mind. There. Your mystery is finished.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"You arranged it?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I connected the buyer to my cousin. I did not receive the money.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"So when you said you knew nothing about the payment, that was false.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"No. You are flattening a commercial transaction into a confession.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You knew the date because you arranged the deposit.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I knew a tractor booking date. Meera later attached her story to it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"My story? You watched Shahid count the notes twice. Bundles of five hundred. You took one bundle back because it was short.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"That is an allegation from a woman whose rental signature has already been called false.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Copied. The examiner called it copied, not false. Do not improve the evidence while quoting it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Then arrest the handwriting.","sfx_cue":"crowd muttering angrily"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The account statement includes a deposit slip reference. Your cousin signed the slip. The depositor field contains initials.","sfx_cue":"pen tapping paper"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Initials are not a person.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"They match the initials used by Shahid on two transport receipts.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Many people share initials.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then bring Shahid here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"You seem very eager to see the man you claim imprisoned you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I am eager for him to see that I came back.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"And that she did not come back alone.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Please. A father's courage, after signing his daughter dead, is not evidence.","sfx_cue":"crowd erupts in overlapping protests"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Quiet. Raghav, threats disguised as insults remain threats when twenty people hear them.","sfx_cue":"wooden ruler striking desk"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I threatened nobody. I am concerned Devraj may damage his health by becoming emotional.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"My health is not in your account.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The tractor. Manufacturer?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"A standard farm model.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Manufacturer?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I don't... I did not handle delivery.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Model number?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Ask my cousin.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"We did. He said you chose the vehicle and brought the buyer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Then he is mistaken.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Your cousin remembers you. You remember the date. Neither of you remembers the buyer.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Or the tractor.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"A booking can be cancelled.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then there should be a refund.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Perhaps there was.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"There was not.","sfx_cue":"paper turned sharply"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Then the amount may have been adjusted against another vehicle.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Which vehicle?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"You have the account. You tell me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"I have every debit for the next six months. No tractor dealer received money from this account.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Cash settlement.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Five lakh rupees in cash, with no receipt?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Village commerce does not always ask police permission.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Neither did you, when you took me to Kota.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"You went willingly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then why did you remove my phone battery?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I did not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Why did you tell Tara I had chosen another life?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I did not speak to Tara.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"You spoke to me. You said searching would shame the children.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I offered practical advice to a distressed family.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You offered us silence. My father accepted it. I will not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Raghav, was the deposit connected to Meera?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"No.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Was it connected to Shahid?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"No.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Was there a tractor?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Yes.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then give me its chassis number by five this evening.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"That deadline is unreasonable.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"You have remembered the transaction for eighteen months. Five hours is generous.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"And if an old office cannot find one number?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then I ask the district transport office whether your tractor ever existed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"You are treating clerical delay as criminal intent.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"I am treating five lakh rupees as five lakh rupees.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"At five, Raghav returned with no chassis number, no invoice and no buyer. Kavita returned with a certified search.","sfx_cue":"rubber stamp striking paper, evening crowd murmuring"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"A registration search proves nothing. Farm vehicles remain unregistered for months.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Not this dealer's vehicles. The dealer says no order was placed by you, your cousin or this account holder.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Dealers lose records.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Banks do not lose the date stamped on a deposit.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Say the dates together.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The money entered your cousin's account on the third of May, twenty twenty-one.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"And I disappeared?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"On the fifth of May, twenty twenty-one.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Coincidence is not evidence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"No. The account is evidence. The dates are evidence. Your changing answers are evidence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"And the tractor?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The account received the five lakh rupees two days before Meera disappeared.","sfx_cue":"certified report placed on desk"},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"But the tractor was never registered.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":11,"title":"Under the Neem Tree","lines":[{"speaker":"tara","text":"Do not let her follow us. If she is really my mother, she will know where to go.","sfx_cue":"garden hoe biting dry earth, children whispering"},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"She is Ma. You heard the lullaby.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You wanted her to be Ma before she opened her mouth.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"And you wanted her to be a stranger.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I wanted nobody to leave twice.","sfx_cue":"small clay object scraping against metal"},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"There. The bird still has one wing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Put it back. Deep. Then cover the soil properly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"What if she does not remember?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Then I stop making excuses for her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"NARRATOR","text":"Tara buried the clay bird again before breakfast. By noon, she had gathered half the village beneath the neem tree.","sfx_cue":"village courtyard crowd, neem leaves rustling"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Why are all these people here?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Because everybody watched when Grandfather called you a stranger. They can watch this too.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Tara, if this is another public test—","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"It is my test. You had yours. Police had theirs. Now I decide.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"What are the rules?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Nobody answers for her. Nobody gives hints. Nobody tells me that fingerprints are enough.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Fingerprints are enough.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Mohan.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Fine. I will not give hints.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Ask.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Not yet. First, tell everyone what you want from this house.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You and Mohan.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"That is not an answer. We are not objects kept in a cupboard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I want to live where my children do. I want to cook badly in my own kitchen. I want to know which schoolbook Mohan has lost this week.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Geography.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"No hints.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"And I want Tara to stop standing near every doorway, ready to run if I say the wrong thing.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I do not do that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You are doing it now.","sfx_cue":"crowd murmuring softly"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Maybe I like the doorway.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You hated doorways. You said they made every room look unfinished.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"That could be in a diary.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You never kept a diary. You wrote one page, then tore it because Mohan drew a buffalo over your secret.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"It looked better.","sfx_cue":"brief laughter from crowd"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"This is not the test.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Then begin it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Before you disappeared, I made something. I hid it. Nobody from police found it. It is not in any statement.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"What did you make?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I said nobody answers for her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"I was only— yes. Ask her.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"What was it?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You made many things. A clay cup that leaked. A horse with five legs.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"So you do not know.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I did not finish.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Then finish.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"A bird.","sfx_cue":"crowd goes quiet"},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"She knows.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"What colour?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"None. You refused paint because you said real sparrows did not wear festival colours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"How many wings?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Two when you made it. One after you dropped it beside the stove.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Where did I hide it?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You told me you threw it away.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Then you do not know where it is.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I know you were lying.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"That is not a place.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You had soil beneath your fingernails. Red soil, not the grey dust near the wall.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"There is red soil in three parts of the courtyard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You came inside with neem leaves caught in your braid.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"There are neem leaves everywhere.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Not in the kitchen. Not behind the water drum. Under this tree.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Where under the tree?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Near the root shaped like a bent knee.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"There are four roots.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"The eastern root. Three handspans from the trunk.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Why there?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Because that was where I buried your first tooth after you asked whether a new one could grow from the ground.","sfx_cue":"crowd murmuring in surprise"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Nobody knew about the tooth.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You and I knew.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I never told Mohan.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"You told me this morning.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"About the bird. Not the tooth.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Has the location ever appeared in a police statement, school record or family testimony?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"No.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Did anyone tell Meera before this test?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"No. I buried it again myself.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Again?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I checked that it was still there.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You dug it up without me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You were dead.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I know what the register said.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"No. You don't... you do not know what that did here. Every person brought food. Every person spoke softly. Then they went home.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"And you stayed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I stayed with a brother who woke up calling for you. I stayed with Grandfather, who said questions were disrespectful.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"Tara, I was ashamed and afraid.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"I am not asking you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You stayed. I was not here. Both are true.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"If I accept you, what happens when police call tomorrow? What happens when Kota calls? What happens when Raghav walks free?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I answer the police. I go to Kota if the inquiry needs me. And every time, I tell you before I leave.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"People promise that when they want entry.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then do not give me trust today. Give me one night.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"One night?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Let me sleep in my house. If you wake, I will be there. If Mohan calls, I will answer. Tomorrow, you decide again.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"She can sleep beside us.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"The house is hers too.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You do not decide that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"devraj","text":"No. I don't. I have decided enough for all of you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"There is no police restriction preventing Meera from staying with her children. The identity certificate remains disputed, not cancelled.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"So the choice is mine?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"The personal choice is yours. The evidence has already made its own.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"The girl has tested her enough. Let the mother enter.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"SECOND VOICE IN CROWD","text":"We all watched her refuse the woman. We should hear her answer now.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Nobody speaks for me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"They did that to you after I disappeared, didn't they?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Every day.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then take your time.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Dig where you said.","sfx_cue":"hoe dropped onto soil"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You want me to dig it up?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Three handspans. Eastern root.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"I will help.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"No. She knows the place.","sfx_cue":"hands scraping dry soil"},{"speaker":"meera","text":"The earth is loose here.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Because I buried it again this morning.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I feel something.","sfx_cue":"clay clicking against a metal bangle"},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Take it out, Ma.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Your bird. One wing. And the beak is still too large.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You said it looked like a crow.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You did not speak to me for two hours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Three hours.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Then I owe you one hour.","sfx_cue":"crowd laughing softly"},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You owe me more than that.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I know.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Tonight, you sleep in the room with us. Not near the door. Mohan kicks when he dreams.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"mohan","text":"Only sometimes.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"And if police call, you wake me before you go.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I will.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Say it properly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I will not leave this house without telling you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Everyone heard that?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"VOICE IN CROWD","text":"Everyone heard.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"Good.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Tara... may I touch you?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"tara","text":"You do not need to ask me that, Mother.","sfx_cue":"quick footsteps, tight embrace"}]},{"ep":12,"title":"The Open Entry","lines":[{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Remove Kota from my statement. Today. Before the court receives another copy.","sfx_cue":"records office door banging open, ledger pages fluttering"},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"You cannot withdraw a place as if it is a spelling mistake.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I can correct a statement taken under public pressure.","sfx_cue":"file dropped onto counter"},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"You signed every page.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Then give me a fresh page.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"This is a records office, not a washing stone.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Your shop is on estate land, isn't it? Paperwork can become tiring when boundaries are reviewed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"My shop has nothing to do with this file.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Of course not. I was expressing concern for your workload.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Express it from the other side of the counter.","sfx_cue":"police boots entering room"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Sub-inspector. Excellent. Tell your clerk that citizens may amend inaccurate statements.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"He is not my clerk. And an amendment does not erase the first statement.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Then attach my correction. Meera was never in Kota with me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You stood before the committee and said I travelled there willingly.","sfx_cue":"crowd gathering at doorway"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I repeated what I had heard. The crowd was shouting. Questions overlapped.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Nobody asked whether you had been to Kota. You volunteered details about a transport fee and the payment date.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I was confused by the accusation.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You were clear enough to call me a woman who abandoned her children.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I withdraw that too.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"You cannot return eighteen months with one sentence.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I am correcting an error. You should be pleased.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"I will be pleased when you say where you left me.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I left you nowhere, because I did not take you anywhere.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Your correction will be recorded as a changed account. State the complete version.","sfx_cue":"recorder button clicking"},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I met Meera near Dharmapur. I did not transport her to Kota. I did not introduce her to Shahid.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"How do you know Shahid's name?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"It has been shouted through the village for days.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Not in front of you.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Villages have ears even when police pretend they do not.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"Continue.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"I know nothing about a room in Kota. I know nothing about confinement. The five lakh rupees were a tractor deposit unrelated to Meera.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"You did not bring the tractor record.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"The transport search was incomplete.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"kavita","text":"It covered every district registration for twelve months after the deposit.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Then perhaps the buyer changed his mind.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"Yesterday, the tractor existed. Today, the buyer changed his mind. Tomorrow, will the account disappear?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"Your confidence is impressive for somebody asking the state to restore her name.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"meera","text":"The state marked me dead. I learned not to borrow confidence from paper.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"Paper also marked the certificate disputed.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"After you interfered with it.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"After police ordered a correction.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"raghav","text":"You are very brave behind that counter.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"babulal","text":"I am... I am careful behind it.
